# Product logo glyphs (for the "connection pieces" frame)

FULL-COLOR official brand marks (icon-only), normalized for inline use.
Inline these into the connection-pieces frame so all three storyboards use identical, correct logos.
Render each on a white/light rounded chip (the disc); the SVG keeps its own multi-color fills, do NOT override fill.

IMPORTANT: Jira and Confluence use internal <linearGradient> ids. When both appear in the SAME html
document the ids must be unique, so they are namespaced here (jiraA/jiraB, confA/confB). Keep them unique.

Sources: Gmail/Slack/Google Drive = Wikimedia; Jira/Confluence = gilbarbara/logos; Databricks = vectorlogo.zone; Claude Code = simple-icons.

NOTE: Claude Code is a single-path glyph in the official brand color, so it DOES carry a fill
(fill="#d97757"). This is the one exception to the "do NOT override fill" rule above.
